declared_mixed_intervals.interpretation: Operator-declared interval, not proof of continuous activity or stability.

limitations: Resource samples are snapshots; phase endpoints use actual marker timestamps and bracketing samples, never interpolation.
Trace byte boundaries establish ordering at capture, not per-line timestamps or completed GPU execution.
Boundary-crossing trace lines remain in overall counts and are separately reported rather than assigned to either phase.
All callback values and outliers are retained. Native frame callbacks are not physical input-to-display timings.
Worker-only durations are unavailable unless separately recorded; no callback/worker subtraction is inferred.
Image-retirement events follow App::drop_image calls; they do not measure GPU/driver resident bytes.
Observation length and markers do not alone prove uninterrupted active mixed review or successful stability.
